blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Villar-led Vista Land & Lifescapes Inc. reported earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (Ebitda) of P24.2 billion in 2025, meeting its full-year target as it renewed its focus on horizontal housing. In a stock exchange filing on Monday, the property developer said consolidated revenues had reached P35.8 billion last year. READ: […]...
